data.body:
[P1] Catch the reconstructed step exception

The base SDK's `StepOperation.get()` reconstructs and rethrows the original exception; `StepFailedException` is only its fallback when reconstruction fails. With the configured default serializer, `charge` therefore throws `RuntimeException("card declined")` past this catch, including during replay. The execution error remains `card declined` instead of the required `payment failed`, causing telemetry-2 to fail despite correct plugin behavior. Catch the reconstructed runtime failure and preserve it as the cause. Add a local handler regression test asserting the outer message and cause; the new configuration tests do not exercise this path.
